mintAuthority.summary: ZARm uses reserve-backed StableTokenV2, not a BorrowerOperations CDP. Minting is restricted to the configured broker, validator and exchange addresses; the current exchange address is zero. The token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay; historical review identified MentoGovernor as sole proposer and an open executor).

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for ZARm
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78939406, ZARm broker() returned this address. The active StableTokenV2 onlyMinter modifier permits broker, validators and exchange; exchange() returned zero. Broker owner() returned Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147. Reserve-backed Broker authorization is not an immutable BorrowerOperations CDP.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (ZARm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78939406, ZARm owner() and its EIP-1967 admin slot returned this Timelock, and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. Historical block 69291577 role reads identified MentoGovernor as proposer and an open executor; that complete membership was not re-enumerated in this read.

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, ZARm owner() resolved to the 172800-second Mento Timelock. At block 72127033, the ZARm EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to StableTokenV2 implementation 0x434563b0...850e and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolved directly to the same Mento Timelock, which can replace mint-critical token logic after its two-day delay. The implementation, admin, owner and delay were re-confirmed at block 78939406 on 2026-10-01. ZARm is reserve-backed; the former BorrowerOperations immutability assertion was not applicable to this deployment. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: cap or minter replacement runs through the enforced two-day Mento Timelock, the live full-composition Mento reserve feed provides continuous reconciliation, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced.
